request: Analyze GSE226005 for PMID 40388671 (Histone Lactylation Antagonizes Senescence and Skeletal Muscle Aging by Modulating Aging-Related Pathways.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

accessions: GSE226005 (RNA-seq SubSeries of GSE226008; GEO Series_pubmed_id 40388671)
final.primary_estimand: Exercise estimand of the paper: effect of 2-month treadmill running vs sedentary on gene expression in gastrocnemius muscle of 11-month-old (13-month at sacrifice) female C57BL/6 mice, measured by snRNA-seq (n = 2 mice per group), per cell type and globally (S2.7.p1, FIG7, S5.2.p1, S5.15.p1).
planned_contrasts: Running vs Sedentary, mouse gastrocnemius snRNA-seq, per cell type (19 cell types) and global; Seurat FindMarkers Wilcoxon (S5.15.p1; DEG counts only in Figure S30B, not in text)
Non-exercise bulk RNA-seq contrasts in IMR90 human fibroblasts (S2.1-S2.3, FIG2): Senescent vs Young, Hypoxia vs Normoxia, 2-DG+Hypoxia vs Hypoxia control (S5.12.p1)

paper_threshold.source_locator: S5.15.p1 (running vs sedentary per cell type: |log2FC| > 0.25 and adjusted P < 0.05; global: |log2FC| > 0.15 and adjusted P < 0.05)

final.paper_method: Exercise: Seurat 4.1.1 FindMarkers Wilcoxon rank-sum on snRNA-seq nuclei (S5.14.p1, S5.15.p1). Bulk IMR90 RNA-seq: featureCounts + DESeq2 1.34.0, |log2FC| > 1 or 0.58 and padj < 0.05 (S5.12.p1).
final.sample_inclusion: Exercise arm: sedentary vs running mice, n = 2 per group for snRNA-seq (FIG7 H). Not part of GSE226005.
final.paper_results: Adipocytes had the most running DEGs (Figure S30B); Ldha up after running (FIG7 J-L); DNA repair and proteostasis pathways up (S2.8.p1).

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: The paper's only exercise transcriptome is mouse gastrocnemius snRNA-seq of running vs sedentary mice (S2.7.p1, FIG7 H-N, S5.9.p1, S5.14.p1, S5.15.p1). The bulk RNA-seq (S5.12.p1) is human IMR90 fibroblasts for senescence/hypoxia/glycolysis-inhibition experiments (FIG2). DA.p1 names only the SuperSeries GSE226008; GSE226005 is its RNA-seq SubSeries (family.soft: 'SubSeries of: GSE226008'; overall design 'RNA-seq data for IMR90 cells during replicative senescence, upon hypoxia and 2-DG treatment').

checks: GSE226005 is a SubSeries of GSE226008, the accession named in DA.p1
12 GSMs = IMR90 bulk RNA-seq (Senescent/Young, Hypoxia/Normoxia, 2-DG+Hypoxia/Hypoxia control), 2 replicates each, matching S5.12.p1 and FIG2
No mouse, muscle, running or sedentary samples in this series (organism_ch1 = Homo sapiens for all 12; cell line IMR90)

ownership.reasoning: The series belongs to the paper, but it holds only the cell-line bulk RNA-seq arm, not the exercise snRNA-seq samples.

alignment.reasoning: The prep script names each tar member's column by its GSM id, which equals the metadata index (exact match, no position use). grp is parsed from the GEO title.

matrix.matrix_type: DESeq2 size-factor-normalized counts (non-integer), normalized separately per experiment batch
matrix.recommended_method: limma on log2(x+1) (raw counts not deposited); not run because the case stops at design
matrix.reasoning: Values are non-integer (e.g. A1BG 17.449); data_processing: 'featureCounts ... normalized with DESeq2 (version 1.34.0) ... tab-delimited text files include normalized values for each sample'. Gene sets differ across sample groups (25,788 missing cells in the merged 17,453 x 12 matrix), consistent with per-experiment filtering and normalization.

design.stop_reason: GSE226005 contains no exercise contrast: all 12 samples are human IMR90 fibroblasts (Senescent/Young, Hypoxia/Normoxia, 2-DG+Hypoxia/Hypoxia control). The paper's exercise estimand (running vs sedentary mouse gastrocnemius, snRNA-seq, S2.7.p1, S5.15.p1) is not in this series, so no exercise effect can be identified from these data. Analyzing a senescence or hypoxia contrast would not answer the exercise question.

candidates.reason_rejected: aging/senescence of a cell line, not exercise
hypoxic culture is not an exercise intervention; the paper does not treat it as an exercise proxy

design.reasoning: The request is the exercise effect as the paper intends. The paper measures it only in mouse muscle snRNA-seq (FIG7 H-N), deposited outside GSE226005 (presumably another SubSeries of GSE226008). No metadata column or title in GSE226005 records running, training, sedentary, mouse or muscle.

discrepancies.paper: Running vs sedentary snRNA-seq of mouse gastrocnemius (S2.7.p1, S5.15.p1); DA.p1 points to SuperSeries GSE226008
discrepancies.data: GSE226005 is the human IMR90 bulk RNA-seq SubSeries only (senescence, hypoxia, 2-DG)
per-sample DESeq2-normalized values only; no raw counts
